card.name: The word use after single
card.fires_on: The word "use" (or "-use") right after "single" in packaging and administration text, as in single-use containers or for single use only. Also a word like "new" after "Use a" when each dose needs fresh equipment.

modes.description: "use" following "single" or "single-patient" when describing containers, packets or syringes.

card.writes: It pushes toward words about disposable or prepaid items and away from words about cycles.
card.plain: It spots the word use in phrases like single-use, meaning the item is thrown away after one use.
